specification.title: Shared Components
specification.description: Common components used throughout the Rezynt application.

component.name: Header
component.description: Main application header component with logo, navigation buttons, stepper and user profile. Supports responsive design and various display configurations for elements.

feature.name: Clickable logo
feature.description: Clicking on the logo navigates to the main page (/) with smart redirection

feature.name: Responsive design
feature.description: Logo is hidden on mobile devices to save space. On mobile screens, the stepper responsively scales labels and icons to ensure all steps fit between navigation arrows and the user avatar without overflow. Back/next arrows and the user avatar sizes are scaled with the same clamp-based logic to stay visually synchronized with the stepper.

feature.name: Navigation buttons
feature.description: "Back" and "Forward" buttons with hover animation

feature.name: Stepper
feature.description: Displays resume creation progress with ability to click on steps. Supports optional clicking of the first step (Start) via allowFirstStepClick prop for guest flows.

feature.name: User profile
feature.description: Avatar with user initials, opening side panel

prop.name: onStepClick
prop.description: Callback for clicking on stepper step

prop.name: allowFirstStepClick
prop.description: Allow clicking on the first step (Start). Useful for unauthenticated guest flows.

detail.name: Navigation
detail.value: useNavigate for navigation to main page

detail.name: Responsiveness
detail.value: Logo hidden on screens up to 768px; stepper uses clamp-based font sizes and reduced active-scale on mobile; arrows use clamp for fontSize and square hit area; avatar uses clamp for width/height and fontSize; container uses flex:1 and minWidth:0 to avoid overflow and allow fitting between arrows and avatar

component.name: HomeRedirect
component.description: Component for smart redirection of users to the main page. Checks if user has resumes and redirects to appropriate page: - If user has resumes → /resumes - If user has no resumes → /start - If user is not authenticated → /auth

feature.name: Smart redirection
feature.description: Automatically determines where to redirect user based on their data

feature.name: Loading handling
feature.description: Shows beautiful loading screen while checking authentication and loading resume data

feature.name: Route protection
feature.description: Works only with authenticated users through ProtectedRoute

detail.name: Redirection logic
detail.value: Check isAuthenticated → Check resume existence → Redirect

component.name: useResumeQuery
component.description: Hook for working with resume data using React Query. Provides data caching and synchronization between components. Allows avoiding repeated server requests when switching between pages.

feature.name: Data caching
feature.description: Automatically caches resume data for 5 minutes (staleTime) and stores in memory for 10 minutes (gcTime)

feature.name: Component synchronization
feature.description: All components using this hook automatically receive updated data

feature.name: Query optimization
feature.description: Does not make repeated requests when component mounts if data is already in cache

feature.name: Cache management
feature.description: Provides functions for updating and invalidating cache

component.name: ResumeRenderer
component.description: Main component for rendering resumes with adaptive scaling support. Component automatically adjusts resume size to fit available container space, maintaining A4 format proportions.

feature.name: Adaptive scaling
feature.description: Resume automatically scales to fill entire available container width and height. Uses ResizeObserver to track container size changes. Container has exact dimensions (width/height = A4 * scale) to prevent overlapping with other elements.

feature.name: Template support
feature.description: Supports various resume templates through template system. Each template can have its unique design and style.

feature.name: Export
feature.description: Supports resume export to PDF and PNG formats. Export is performed with high quality (2x scale). PDF export uses padding only at template level (38px 30px padding for printing), ensuring exact preview match.

feature.name: Preview mode
feature.description: Supports preview mode with shadow and rounded corners, as well as export mode with full A4 size.

detail.name: Padding
detail.value: Preview padding: 40px, template printing padding: 38px 30px (increased by 1.5x)

detail.name: Animation
detail.value: CSS transition for smooth scale changes

component.name: Resume Templates
component.description: Resume template system with support for various designs and styles. All templates inherit from BaseTemplate and ensure correct display when exporting to PDF.

feature.name: AltoTemplate
feature.description: Template with logo-initials in square frame, positioned to the left of the name. Contact information placed to the right. Uses brown color scheme (#8B4513). Optimized for printing with width limitation and overflow: hidden.

feature.name: VeroTemplate
feature.description: Centered template with name in center and contact information below. Sections separated by horizontal lines. Uses brown color scheme (#8B4513). Optimized for printing with width limitation and overflow: hidden.

feature.name: LumaTemplate
feature.description: Two-column template with dark sidebar (35%) and main content (65%). Contacts and skills placed in sidebar. Uses fixed column widths. Optimized for printing with overflow: hidden.

feature.name: PDF Export Optimization
feature.description: All templates are optimized for PDF export with proper width and height limitation. Use maxWidth: 100%, maxHeight: 100vh, boxSizing: border-box and overflow: hidden to prevent going beyond boundaries. Special styles for @media print with reduced padding (20px 30px) and inter-section spacing (15px).

detail.name: BaseTemplate
detail.value: Base class with common methods for formatting dates and work periods

detail.name: Responsive Design
detail.value: Responsive layout with flexbox and grid for correct display on different screens

detail.name: Print Styles
detail.value: Special styles for printing with reduced fonts, padding (20px 30px) and inter-section spacing (15px)

detail.name: Color Scheme
detail.value: Unified brown color scheme (#8B4513) for all templates

detail.name: Typography
detail.value: Use of system fonts Arial and Source Sans Pro for better readability
